description:
We want to change the world. We’re a team of fast-executing social entrepreneurs on a mission to build the future of social change. You want to change the world? This is your chance!
  
 We are searching for an exceptional mobile app developer to build our business with. You will work closely with our CTO and other members of the Core Team to design and develop world-changing mobile apps for iOS and Android platforms.
  
 We don’t want a code monkey; we don’t want someone to say yes and implement every feature we ask for. What we want is a partner. Someone to bounce ideas off of, someone with a vision for the future of our company, and someone who has the desire and drive to make it a reality.
  
 We want the best of the best. We’ve built a team of supremely talented and dedicated individuals, and we want our app developer to be the same.

 
 At least 1-2 years of experience developing mobile applications across their entire life cycle -- concept, design, build, deploy, test, release to app stores and support

 Deep technical knowledge of iOS mobile app development, including Objective C

 Preferred knowledge of Android development as well, including Java, GIT, Android Studio, RESTful APIs, and know-how of prominent Android guidelines by Google and its official libraries

 Knowledge of design guidelines by Google and Apple

 Ability to integrate social APIs with apps

 Ability to use prototyping and wireframing tools

 Preferred: At least one iOS app showcasing your work in the App Store

 Must be passionate about quality software and writing clean code

 

 This job requires a commitment of about 20 hours/week and is unpaid to start. After we raise our Angel round of funding, there is the potential for this role to grow into a full-time position with a full salary and vested equity in iFLIP4, assuming the work you do is great! We are located in East Hanover, NJ, and telecommuting is fine with us.
 Please send your resume to Team [at] iFLIP4.com. Preference will be given to those who apply earliest.
